title: Activation of a Granite Ridge Season Pass and the Start of Its Entitlements
content:
A pass becomes scannable only once the money due before access has been taken and the identity requirements of the tier have been met.

**The opening money.** The pass is activated only when the collective's pass account records show the deposit, or the first scheduled instalment, already cleared against this pass.

**The photograph.** Where the tier requires a passholder photograph, activation waits until the photograph is on file; a photograph the guest says they uploaded but which the record does not show is not enough.

**What activation does.** Activation issues pass media, writes the serial of that media to the pass record and stamps the activation date.

**The buddy allotment.** The buddy lift ticket allotment of the tier is loaded onto the pass in the same step and is the allotment for the whole season; it is not topped up later and does not carry into the next season. The allotment is loaded only while the pass record stands in the pending activation or active state. A pass that is activated after the season has already opened still receives the full allotment, because the allotment is a property of the tier and not of the days remaining.

**Standing entitlements.** Activation is also what opens the tier's standing entitlements, so from that moment the priority lift lane, early lift loading before public opening, the complimentary parking days and the reductions the tier carries on lodging, equipment rental, snowsports school, on-mountain dining and resort retail are read off the pass whenever a charge is raised against the household. An entitlement the tier does not carry is not applicable rather than zero, and none of them stands before the pass is activated.

### Points of judgement

*What counts as the opening money.* Either the deposit or the first scheduled instalment, shown as cleared against this pass on the collective's own pass account records. One of the two is enough; both are not required.

*Whose word settles the photograph.* The record. A tier that requires a photograph is not activated on an assurance that one was sent.

*A pass standing applied.* The allotment is loaded only in the pending activation or active state, so a record still standing applied receives no allotment in that step.

*A late activation.* A Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass activated in February receives the same allotment as one activated in November, because the allotment answers to the tier and not to the calendar.
